end.parentNote: Asha practised naming equal parts of shapes and finding a fraction of a collection. Nisha used the equal-groups method for 1/3 of 15 and found 5, and later stated that the denominator shows the total equal parts; they still mixed this up in collection examples such as 1/3 of 9. At home, share small groups of objects equally and ask, “How many equal groups? How many in one group?”
